title: Practice Quiz: String Operations
question: What will be printed to the console by the following Python program?
code:
a = "20"
b = 5
result = a * 2 + str(b)
print(result)
explanation_correct:
EXCELLENT!
"20" * 2 repeats the string to "2020", and concatenating str(5) yields "20205".
explanation_incorrect:
Not quite!
Remember that multiplying a string repeats it (e.g. "hi" * 2 becomes "hihi"), rather than performing arithmetic addition. Try again!
